item1.justification: The trace applies element-focused anticipation under §102, Graham/KSR-style factors and result-effective-variable analysis under §103, and specification-support, enablement, and definiteness inquiries under §112.

item2.justification: The conclusions are tied to specific limitations such as the 60–85% porosity range, hollow-fiber form, formulas (I)–(XI), and “incorporated therein,” as well as US-2015136692-A1.

item3.justification: The office action inconsistently calls claim 2 “not novel” after the novelty stage found it novel and the same action concedes that the exact porosity range is not disclosed, although it ultimately proceeds only under §103.

item4.justification: The mixed disposition—rejecting claims on supported grounds while recognizing allowable subject matter in claim 5—reasonably reflects the examiner’s moderate strictness and moderate combination threshold.

item5.justification: The final rejection directly follows the office-action grounds for claims 2–4 and 6–8 while consistently treating claim 5 as potentially allowable if rewritten.
